node.title: Re: Failes to find a module with Strawbery 5.30
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Have you checked that Capture.pm actually exists in one of those locations? Do you perhaps have two versions of Perl on this machine (and the installation accidentally went to the wrong one)? What method did you use to install the module (cpan, cpanm, etc.)? Perhaps you could try running the installation again and showing us the output, in tags.
